title: UK Asset Manager Functional Architecture: Active, Passive/ETF and Alternatives

layers.name: Clients and Distribution
layers.purpose: How clients, distributors and LPs are won, onboarded, served and reported to.

components.name: Client CRM
components.does: Records clients, intermediaries, consultants, contacts and interactions

components.name: Sales Pipeline and RFP
components.does: Tracks opportunities, RFPs, due diligence questionnaires and consultant ratings

components.name: Fundraising and LP Pipeline
components.does: Manages target LPs, commitments, closings and side-letter negotiation

components.name: Client Onboarding Workflow
components.does: Orchestrates client categorisation (retail, professional, eligible counterparty), due diligence, FATCA/CRS self-certification, account opening and documentation

components.name: Mandate and Agreement Repository
components.does: Holds IMAs, LPAs, side letters, fee terms and investment guidelines

components.name: Distributor Data Hub
components.does: Exchanges target market, costs, share-class and listing data with distributors

components.name: Client and Adviser Portal
components.does: Self-service holdings, reports, documents and dealing for clients and advisers

components.name: LP Investor Portal
components.does: Delivers capital notices, LP reports, tax documents and data-room access

components.name: Public Fund Website
components.does: Publishes prices, factsheets, holdings disclosures and legal documents

components.name: Client Reporting Engine
components.does: Produces factsheets, mandate reports, statements and commentary packs

components.name: LP Reporting Engine
components.does: Produces quarterly LP reports and ILPA fee and performance templates

components.name: Client Case Management
components.does: Logs queries, complaints and outcomes (Consumer Duty evidence for retail products)

layers.name: Investment Management
layers.purpose: Where investment decisions are researched, made and monitored across the three segments.

components.name: Research Management
components.does: Captures notes, models, ratings, house views, company engagement, research budget and payment account

components.name: ESG and Sustainability Data
components.does: Holds ESG scores, controversies, climate metrics and exclusion lists

components.name: Portfolio Management System
components.does: Models portfolios, cash, target weights and what-if scenarios

components.name: Portfolio Optimiser
components.does: Constructs portfolios against risk model, constraints and transaction costs

components.name: Investment Book of Record
components.does: Real-time start-of-day and intraday positions and cash for decisions

components.name: Index Data Management
components.does: Ingests constituents, weights, index events and licence entitlements

components.name: Replication and Rebalance Engine
components.does: Generates model baskets, sampling and rebalance trade lists

components.name: Tracking Error Analytics
components.does: Measures and attributes tracking difference and tracking error

components.name: Deal Pipeline Management
components.does: Logs, screens and tracks deals from origination to committee

components.name: Due Diligence Workspace
components.does: Coordinates data-room review, adviser workstreams, findings and red flags

components.name: Deal Modelling and IC
components.does: Hosts returns models, investment papers, IC decisions and cross-fund allocations

components.name: Portfolio Company Monitoring
components.does: Collects portfolio company KPIs, financials and value-creation plan progress

components.name: Loan and Covenant Monitoring
components.does: Tracks private credit loans, covenants, interest, amortisation and watchlists

components.name: Real Asset Management
components.does: Holds property and infrastructure data, leases, capex and operations

components.name: Proxy Voting Platform
components.does: Receives ballots, applies voting policy, lodges and records votes

components.name: Engagement Tracker
components.does: Records engagement objectives, escalations and outcomes for stewardship reporting

layers.name: Trading and Execution
layers.purpose: Turning decisions into executed trades, primary-market ETF activity, deal completion and treasury.

components.name: Order Management System
components.does: Captures orders, aggregates blocks and allocates fills fairly to accounts

components.name: Pre-Trade Compliance
components.does: Checks orders against mandate, regulatory and house restrictions

components.name: Execution Management System
components.does: Routes orders to brokers, venues and algorithms; captures fills

components.name: TCA and Best Execution
components.does: Measures execution quality; evidences best-execution policy, venue and broker reviews

components.name: Creation and Redemption Platform
components.does: Takes authorised participant orders; manages in-kind and cash settlement

components.name: Basket (PCF) and iNAV Publication
components.does: Publishes daily baskets, indicative NAV and premium/discount monitoring

components.name: ETF Listing and AP Management
components.does: Maintains AP and market-maker agreements, onboarding reviews, listings and venue obligations

components.name: Deal Closing Management
components.does: Manages signing, consents, completion funds flows and deal financing

components.name: Fund Financing Management
components.does: Manages subscription lines, asset-level debt, drawdowns and deal hedging

components.name: Exit and Realisation Management
components.does: Runs sale processes, vendor diligence, completion proceeds, escrows, earn-outs and warranty claims

components.name: FX and Cash Management
components.does: Executes share-class hedging, FX, cash sweeps and liquidity forecasts

components.name: Collateral and Margin Management
components.does: Calculates margin, eligible collateral and haircuts for OTC and exchange-traded derivatives

components.name: Securities Lending Programme Oversight
components.does: Oversees agent lending, loans, recalls, collateral and revenue split

layers.name: Investment Operations and Accounting
layers.purpose: Post-trade, books of record, valuation, NAV, investor servicing and private fund administration.

components.name: Trade Capture and Enrichment
components.does: Books executions, enriches settlement instructions and validates trade data

components.name: Confirmation and Matching
components.does: Matches allocations and confirmations with brokers and custodians

components.name: Settlement and Fails Management
components.does: Instructs settlement, tracks status and manages fails and penalties

components.name: Fund Investment Dealing and Look-Through
components.does: Places subscriptions and redemptions into in-house and third-party funds; captures look-through holdings for risk and compliance

components.name: Accounting Book of Record
components.does: Official positions, transactions, accruals and income of record for listed funds and mandates; feeds C49

components.name: Reconciliation Engine
components.does: Reconciles positions, cash and trades with custodians and administrators

components.name: Corporate Actions and Income
components.does: Captures events, takes elections, reconciles entitlements, reclaims withholding tax (fund and treaty reclaims) and tracks UK reporting fund status for offshore feeders

components.name: Client Money and Assets (CASS)
components.does: Client money and custody asset records, daily internal and external reconciliations, DvP exemption tracking, resolution pack and regulatory return

components.name: Pricing and Valuation Control
components.does: Sources prices, runs tolerance, stale-price and fair-value challenges

components.name: Illiquid Asset Valuation
components.does: Runs periodic private asset valuations and valuation committee evidence

components.name: Performance and Attribution
components.does: Calculates returns, attribution, composites, IRR and multiples

components.name: Fund Accounting and NAV
components.does: Calculates daily NAV, fee accruals, swing pricing or dilution adjustments, and fund financial statements
components.bian: Mutual Fund Administration; Unit Trust Administration

components.name: Transfer Agency and Register
components.does: Processes dealing, unitholder register, distributions and investor tax reporting

components.name: Box Management and Dealing Control
components.does: Manages the manager's box, dealing as principal, daily unit creation and cancellation instructions, and dealing errors

components.name: Partnership Accounting
components.does: Maintains fund, feeder and SPV accounts and investor allocations

components.name: LP Register and Commitments
components.does: Holds commitments, unfunded amounts, transfers and side-letter terms

components.name: Capital Call and Distribution
components.does: Calculates and issues capital calls, distributions and equalisation
components.msg: ILPA Capital Call and Distribution Template

components.name: Fee and Carry Engine
components.does: Calculates management fees, offsets, waterfalls and carried interest

components.name: Legal Entity and SPV Management
components.does: Holds fund, GP, feeder and SPV structures, directors, filings and entity governance calendar

layers.name: Product, Risk, Compliance and Regulatory
layers.purpose: Second-line oversight, product governance and regulatory output across all segments.

components.name: Product Lifecycle and Approval
components.does: Runs product approval, target market, periodic reviews and closures

components.name: Assessment of Value and Fair Value
components.does: Assesses fair value and consumer outcomes for board reporting

components.name: Product Disclosure Documents
components.does: Produces prospectus, CCI product summary, costs and sustainability disclosures

components.name: Market and Liquidity Risk
components.does: Computes VaR, stress tests, exposures, leverage, liquidity risk and liquidity-tool triggers

components.name: Counterparty and Credit Exposure
components.does: Monitors counterparty, issuer and collateral exposure against limits

components.name: Post-Trade Compliance Monitor
components.does: Monitors portfolios for guideline and LPA restriction breaches and runs breach workflow

components.name: Market Abuse Surveillance
components.does: Detects abuse patterns across orders, trades, voice and chat

components.name: Restricted and Insider Lists
components.does: Manages wall-crossings, insider lists, restricted and watch lists across public and private sides

components.name: Financial Promotions Approval
components.does: Reviews marketing communications, including anti-greenwashing checks

components.name: Conduct and SM&CR Register
components.does: Holds responsibilities map, certifications, conflicts, gifts and breaches registers

components.name: KYC and Screening
components.does: Performs investor, counterparty and deal-party due diligence, sanctions and PEP screening

components.name: Third-Party Oversight

components.name: NAV and Administrator Oversight
components.does: Exception-based or shadow NAV checks, NAV and pricing error handling, TA and administrator KPI review, sign-off evidence

components.name: Depositary and Trustee Liaison
components.does: Manages depositary oversight queries, cash-monitoring breaks, unit issue/cancellation confirmations and breach reporting

components.name: Transaction Reporting
components.does: Generates and reconciles regulatory transaction reports for listed trades

components.name: Regulatory Returns Engine
components.does: Produces AIFM, fund, prudential and conduct returns to regulators
components.msg: FCA RegData / AIFMD Annex IV XML (confirm)

components.name: Sustainability and Stewardship Reporting
components.does: Produces SDR, climate and Stewardship Code reports

components.name: Derivatives and SFT Reporting

components.name: Desktop Interoperability

components.name: Identity and Access Management

components.name: Document and Records Archive

assumptions: Archetype: UK-authorised manager acting as authorised fund manager for UK UCITS/OEICs and ETFs, and as UK AIFM for closed-ended private funds; segregated institutional mandates also in scope.

Fund accounting, NAV, transfer agency and private fund administration are often outsourced; components flagged external=true are commonly run by an administrator, TA, custodian or specialist agent, but the manager keeps oversight and data ownership through Delegate Oversight (C80-C82).
Hedge funds, synthetic replication, wealth/advice and the manager's own HR/procurement are out of scope; derivatives appear only as overlay, hedging and collateral.
Segment tags: A = Active long-only listed, P = Passive/ETF, L = Alternatives (PE, private credit, real assets); ALL = shared across all three. Components tagged A,P serve both listed businesses.

BIAN names come from the publicly visible v10 value chain view; later releases may rename or add domains. BIAN is bank-centric, so mapped names are closest-fit, not exact equivalence; empty means no matching domain was seen.

CALM 1.1 node-type and relationship vocabulary is used for legend labels only (actor, ecosystem, system, service, database, network, ldap, webclient, data-asset). This is not a CALM document: flows and controls are not modelled, and FIX and Swift are message standards, not CALM protocols.

ISO 20022 entries cite verified business areas (setr, sese, semt, seev, colr, reda, auth, acmt via Swift doc); specific message-level mapping (e.g. setr for fund orders, seev for proxy voting, camt for cash statements) is analyst knowledge and should be confirmed.

UK rules named but not verified in this run: Consumer Duty, SM&CR, UK UCITS/COLL, UK AIFM regime, UK MiFIR transaction reporting, FATCA/CRS, operational resilience, CASS and UK EMIR/SFTR. SDR, CCI (PS25/20) and Stewardship Code 2026 were verified.
Functional system view only: no agentic AI layer, no vendor or product names, no market statistics.
Links show representative flows only, not the full integration estate; most components also read from the Platform layer.

IBOR sits in Investment Management (decision support); ABOR sits in Operations (official record). Many firms merge them or outsource ABOR to the administrator. Alternatives positions are held in C24-C26 and C51; a total-portfolio view comes from the data platform (C72).
